label: sprite-suite-steel
mode: Actual FightEngine with native Canvas; not browser screenshots

visualFindings.orientation: Steel Guardian turns its head and central body toward Anne in both slot orders. The distinct side-facing combat silhouette is used.
visualFindings.combatExterior: Both mechanical wings, horn/spike tips, hanging blades, visible chains, hands and long foot claws remain complete in both final captures.
visualFindings.portraitExterior: Both 500 by 500 selection portraits were inspected. The broad frontal wings, hanging chains/blades and claws are complete despite the source portrait narrow vertical margin.
visualFindings.alpha: The stage/portrait background remains visible around and between the silhouette parts. No opaque rectangle or conspicuous background halo observed at the displayed sizes.
visualFindings.hoverAnchor: The lowest visible point is 4.3607 px above the engine ground in both slots; the central body and claws visibly hang above the shadow. This agrees with the requested suspended pose.
visualFindings.camera: Real engine camera scale is 0.9303687252 in both duels. The exterior wing retains 28.6819 px from the nearest viewport edge, so the wide asymmetric silhouette is included.
visualFindings.selectionIsolation: Draw tracing confirms only assets/sprites/bom_steel_guardian_146.221d68a36f7a.png is used for Steel in combat; selection uses assets/sprites/bom_steel_guardian_146.34f6a40e4729.png.
visualFindings.calibration: The supplied anchor [0.725, 0.98] and bodyHeight 0.86 require no correction for these idle views.

limits: Only static idle and intro/pause paths were exercised; no source animation, attack/collision fidelity or 1:1 fidelity is certified.
Left-facing appearance is the engine mirror, not a separately sourced opposite-side asset.
No blade or chain-link count is certified by this game render review.
Browser DOM, CSS, input, decoding and service worker were not tested.
Sharp normalizes PNG encoding losslessly in memory; source PNGs remain unchanged.
